newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BPSM, BTA pref shares to boost capital.
newsitem.headline: BPSM, BTA pref shares to boost capital.

text.p: Banco Pinto e Sotto Mayor and Banco Totta e Acores made a joint launch in New York on Thursday of $250 million of preference shares, whose main purpose was to boost the capital of both banks, an official of one of the banks said.
"The objective was to reinforce the solvability of the banks," the official, who asked not to be identified, told Reuters, confirming a report in Diario Economico newspaper.
He said the new capital would be divided equally between the two banks.
The source said the perpetual, non-vote preference shares were placed among foreign investors.
BPSM shares stood up 67 escudos to 1,831 in volume of 289,900 at 1022 GMT and BTA traded at 3,443, up 24, in volume of 59,509.
